address: Rua Manuel Guedes 474, São Paulo, 04536-070, Brazil
bio: A real oasis of elegance that is immediately evident the moment you step through the door. Occupying a former bread factory, Cantaloup features high ceilings and a spacious and stylish dining room complemented by a classic-style bar in the corner. Next to it is an attractive waiting area protected by a retractable roof that provides plenty of light, which combines pleasantly with a charming green space and a fountain that adds a hint of freshness to the overall feel. Chef Valdir Oliveira offers an attractive menu based around international recipes that he creates via strong technique and well-defined combinations.
